title: Solar System Explorer — explainer overview
notes: Warm gift framing + Mission Flight + Free Flight playground. Synced 1:1 with slides in tools/make_demo_videos.sh (7 beats).

lines.text: This is Solar System Explorer — another world on Star Learner, made for a six-year-old who wants to fly among the planets.
At the start you choose: Spaceship to fly, or Solar System for a quiet narrated tour of the planets around the Sun.
Inside Spaceship you pick Mission Flight for charted courses, or Free Flight to pilot yourself in a 3D playground.
Mission Flight draws a top-down path. Worlds are moving, so the ship aims ahead — then engines burn, coast, and brake along that course.
You fly it for real — planets stay little icons until you get close, and diving through the asteroid belt is a rush of tumbling rocks.
Free Flight puts you in the cockpit: tilt the phone to steer, then pull or push to change speed — five gears, cruise and stop, or a joystick test.
Park in orbit, learn more with a short video, or chart a new course. Wonder is the reward.
